NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Coca Cola (KO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 31.7 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · KO: $47.9B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · KO: +1.9%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · KO: 28.7%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · KO: 27.3%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · KO: 11.0%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · KO: 5.5%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · KO Dec 31, 2025. The periods are not identical.
